==Description==
'''Night Station''' is a night-time [[Maps|map]]. It takes place in a train station surrounded by mountains.

==Path & Design==
{{Tabber
|Current
|'''Night Station''' is a map which takes place at a train station next to a road, with multiple lamps, waiting shelters, benches, railways, walls and fences. The train station is surrounded by grass mountains, with some trees on them. Several trailers can be seen on the railways.

The path begins at a cave located near the grassy area, taking multiple turns and going through the train station, and ends at a road tunnel.
|Version 1
|'''Night Station''' was a map which took place at a train depot station, with multiple parallel railway lines, level crossings and signal scaffolding. The depot yard was surrounded by grassy mountains, with some trees on top of them. Several locomotives and trailers could have been seen in the depot. A large brick building and a watch tower could also have been seen.

The path begins and ends at two road tunnels. The path crosses most of the railway lines.
}}

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Night Station}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal}}

==Strategy==
*You cannot place ground towers near the railway tracks. Therefore, you need to find an appropriate spot where you can place down towers.
**There is a lot of ground space for towers near the entrance. However, there is a limited amount of cliff space there.
*Cliff-based towers can be quite useful on this map, though be aware that this map's cliff spots are rather spaced out.
**If you want to use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost your cliff towers, it is recommended to place your towers on the trailers near the waiting shelters.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can also increase the range of the [[Commander]], allowing it to boost towers in a larger area.
